name: KSE 100 Index
description: Benchmark index tracking the top 100 companies by market capitalization.

name: KSE 100 Price Return Index
description: A price return (PR) version of the KSE-100 index.

name: All Share Index
description: Measures the performance of all companies listed on the exchange.

name: KSE 30 Index
description: Tracks the top 30 most liquid companies listed on the PSX.

name: KMI 30 Index
description: Tracks the 30 most liquid Shariah-compliant companies.

name: Banks Tradable Index
description: Sector index that tracks the performance of major listed banks.

name: Oil & Gas Tradable Index
description: Sector index tracking the performance of the Oil & Gas industry.

name: PSX-KMI All Shares Index
description: Comprises all Shariah-compliant companies listed on the PSX.

name: UPP9 Index
description: Tracks top 9 companies from KSE-100 by free-float cap (excl. Oil & Gas).

name: NITPG Index
description: Tracks stocks representing the top 50% free-float market cap of the KSE-100.

name: NBPPGI Index
description: Tracks the top 15 companies by free-float market cap in the KSE-100.

name: MZNPI Index (Meezan Pakistan)
description: Tracks top 12 Shariah-compliant companies from the KMI30 Index.

name: JSMF Index
description: A momentum-based index based on total return and traded value.

name: ACIETF Index (Alfalah Consumer)
description: A consumer-focused index comprising a maximum of 20 stocks.

name: JSGBKTI Index (JS Global Banking)
description: Tracks the total return performance of the Banking Sector Tradable Index (BKTi).

name: HBL Total Treasury Index
description: The underlying index for the HBL Total Treasury ETF.

name: MII30 Index (Mahaana Islamic)
description: Tracks top 30 Shariah-compliant companies based on free-float cap.
